Two distinct appearances, merged into one record per rule 4. First as the water of the 20%, 30% and 40% 含水甲醇 in batches 11, 12 and 13, extracted out of the mixture the way the shared canonical identifier table directs. Second as 10g新水 (10 g of fresh water) in batch 11 only, added after the methanol has been stripped off and before the hydrochloric acid; that charge is the 10.0 in quantity.mass_g and it is the only stated mass of water in the section. Batch 11 therefore carries an operation that batches 12 and 13 do not, so it is not a clean water-content comparison against them even though the water content of the methanol is the section's stated variable. 新水 is recorded as an alias and not as a second compound.

1g活性炭 charged in each of the three batches and held for one hour at 60℃ before hot filtration; one record merged per rule 4, with quantity.mass_g 1.0, the charge stated identically in all three batches of THIS section. role additive because the role enum has no value for an adsorbent, per the shared canonical identifier table. compound_class is workup_agent: that enum has no adsorbent value either, workup_agent is rule 18's nearest mapping (the line that sends drying and workup agents there), and it is what the other sections of this patent tagged. finalise.py unions tags rather than choosing, so a different compound_class here would leave the merged record carrying two values where rule 18 allows exactly one; aligning is the only way the merged record ends with one. The 1 g is NOT undisputed across the merge. Batches 11 to 13 here charge 1 g, and so does every other batch of Examples 1 to 4 that charges activated carbon at all (batch 15 charges 1 g of diatomaceous earth instead), but Example 6 at [0053] charges 5 g of activated carbon at a larger scale. The schema holds one mass per compound, example-6.json sorts after example-3.json, and the merge keeps the last non-empty value, so the merged record in the deliverable will carry the Example 6 charge and not a figure representative of the purification batches. This section charges 1 g, so this record states 1 g. The section states no grade and no source, and names no removal step beyond 热过滤 (hot filtration).

notes: Named only in the [0043] lead-in and in the table column headers 原始氰化物杂质含量（ppm）, 处理后氰化物杂质含量（ppm） and 氰化物杂质含量降低%. It is a class and not one compound, and this section never says which cyanide species, so resolved is false and no chemical_family or functional_group tag is emitted; unresolved_reference is false because this is a class name and not a reference to a compound named elsewhere. All four ppm figures are the cyanide impurity content and belong here as analytics, not in any quantity field and not on tembotrione. No analytical method is stated for any of them, so analytics method is other. All three batches start from the same 1257 ppm, and every one of the three printed reduction percentages disagrees with its own ppm pair: 1257 to 31 is printed as 96%, 1257 to 37 as 95%, and 1257 to 12 as 98%. Per rule 21 the percentages are recorded exactly as printed and nothing is recomputed. The lowest residue is at 40% water, the top of claim 1's 20% to 40% range rather than the middle of it, and batch 11 is not strictly comparable with 12 and 13 because it alone strips off the methanol and adds 10 g of fresh water before the acid.
